description: Configuration for multi-index system with path-based blob storage filtering. Each index has its own blob path prefix and Azure indexer filters.

internal.name: gptkbindex-internal
internal.description: Internal CMO - ALL training data from every folder

display.title: Internal CMO
display.subtitle: Access all training data - Ask anything about Pheydrus courses and programs

public.name: gptkbindex-public
public.description: Public CMO - Only Artist's Way and Business Growth folders

display.title: Public CMO
display.subtitle: Access Artist's Way and Business Growth content

notes: To include ALL folders in an index, set folders to ["*"]
To include specific folders, list them explicitly in the folders array
Each index uses path-based blob storage: blobs are stored at {blob_path_prefix}/{filename}
Azure indexers filter by blob_path_prefix, so each index only sees its own blobs
Frontend can modify this file to change folder assignments
Run prepdocs.ps1 or prepdocs.sh after changes to reindex
